Committee on Zoning
ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District and RS-3, Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District and indications as shown on Map No. 7-J in the area bound by:

Wrightwood Avenue; a line 118 feet east of and parallel to North Pulaski Road; the alley
next south of and parallel to West Wrightwood Avenue; and a line 148 feet east of and
parallel to North Pulaski Road,

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Auithiny F Qeergedla

Antfiony J. Quezada
Alderman, 35" Ward

Common Address:
3947 W. Wrightwood
